note: model_class task: online inputs are generated by get_inputs() inside the task file (the evaluator calls it after set_seed; the values of x/a/b consume the global RNG, and the forms of a/b are also drawn independently and with equal probability from the four-form pool, so multiple correctness trials therefore cover combinations of scalar/single-element/same-shape tensors). This file records the fixed shape family and the form pool of get_inputs as the machine-readable version of the task-statement contract; tolerances and global-domain shape constraints live in task.yaml.

kind_semantics.scalar_float: Python float scalar (value drawn as randn*100)
kind_semantics.scalar_int: Python int scalar (value drawn as randn*100 truncated)
kind_semantics.tensor1: single-element tensor shape (1,), same dtype as x
kind_semantics.tensor_full: tensor with the same shape as x, same dtype as x
